title: Seed MockLab vault config.yaml kitchen-sink flags + trees
description:
Follow docs/architecture/short-stack-tool-placement.md.

Fat-guest kitchen-sink config (lp-zuh.4) died with the tool-only pin. Harness settings snapshot reads BACKEND_HOME/config.yaml plus skills/workflow trees. Empty home → Tools page honestly empty.

Seed live MockLab vault config with subagents.enabled, workflow.enabled, mempalace.enabled (search-only writes), tools.catalog_search, cron.enabled, skills.disabled=[], plus skill/workflow files already in the vault prefix. Point harness BACKEND_HOME at that material (or the same document CP/S3 already serves).

Do not restore a fat snapshot.
acceptance_criteria:
- [ ] Live GET /api/settings/snapshot source=harness is not an empty fixture: skills or workflows or mcp or models present as honestly configured.
- [ ] config.yaml has subagents.enabled, mempalace.enabled, workflow.enabled for MockLab lab.
- [ ] Guest still has no lanyard-agent tree.
notes:
Playbook: feature.md. architect skipped: bead already picks Shape A (vault config.yaml + skills/workflow trees as the same document harness BACKEND_HOME projects; not a fat guest snapshot). Throughput: blocking=seed pack+config.yaml flags; independent=CP pack test vs deploy smoke vs harness BACKEND_HOME wiring; shared mutable=vault seed tree + mockLabVaultSeedPack (serialize those writes); smallest decomposition=one worker (single seed document). Principles: model-the-domain (BACKEND_HOME layout: config.yaml + skills/ + workflows/), foundational-thinking (data first), laziness (fill-missing not --force wipe), redesign-from-first-principles (config lives in vault seed, not guest entrypoint), boundary-discipline (validate flags at seed/smoke edge), type-system-discipline (pack VaultSeedObject), separate-before-serializing (image COPY vs S3 seed vs live vault edits), build-the-lever (check-mocklab-kitchen-sink-config.py + materialize script), prove-it-works (seed as BACKEND_HOME inventory, guest no lanyard-agent tree).
PR: https://github.com/LanyardBrain/lanyard-platform/pull/558 SHA 372197f2. Offline smokes PASS: smoke-seed-mocklab-s3-vault, smoke-mocklab-harness-backend-home, smoke-mocklab-short-stack-harness, smoke-mocklab-replace-echo-harness-la. vault-seed.test.ts 22 passed. acceptance_criteria:
- [ ] Chat can create a scheduled task on MockLab without a guest agent tree.
- [ ] Job row lands in vault cron/jobs.json (CP-readable).

title: Bind memory_read/write via toolbox MemPalace CLI

MemPalace CLI is already on the tool-only snapshot (/usr/local/bin/mempalace). Palace dir is /mnt/vault/mempalace. Fargate does not have that disk.

title: Doc: short-stack tool placement (harness vs toolbox vs CP)
description:
Canonical doctrine for every chat tool after the MockLab cutover.

The model talks to LiteLLM from the Fargate harness. Daytona is a computer (toolbox process/execute), not a second agent. No per-tool HTTP API to the sandbox.

Write docs/architecture/short-stack-tool-placement.md (inventory, cron path, MCP, how to add a tool). Link from plan 0015 and the short-stack ADR.
design: Placement classes: harness in-process, toolbox one-shot CLI, platform-then-harness (scheduled fire), not-a-tool. MCP stdio that needs vault is NOT toolbox execute.
